what: When the body reaches the center of the screen it pins for steps × 100%, and at each step boundary the current step’s title·text·number slide up −50% while fading (.25), and .25 later the next step rises from 50% below — the images move less, at ±25%. .3 pause between steps. The ruler strip below (several ruler-width cells) slides left linearly throughout the pin by (steps − 1) × ruler width, so the Current step marker passes by

options.step: Exit and enter durations (share of timeline), default .25 — entering starts after exit ends
options.shift: Distance the text moves up and down (%), default 50
options.pic: Distance the picture moves up and down (%), default 25
options.length: Fixed scroll length per step (screen %), default 100
options.[data-fx-part=step]: Rising and falling text — order within the same parent is the step number, so separate title, text, and number groups move together by nth item
options.[data-fx-part=track]·[data-fx-part=seg]: Ruler strip that slides sideways and its cells (optional) — cells are the ruler ([data-fx-part=ruler] or the band’s parent) width is matched
options.[data-fx-part=body]: Panel to pin (optional) — if none, the attached element

from.where: index.html .w-timeline — original c-timeline: pin center center, end +=n×100%, scrub true, exit·enter .25 (enter is +.25), rest .3, text ±50%·image ±25%, ruler x −(n−1)×width (ease none), default curve default-ease .625,.05,0,1
